notes.title: Small Update
notes.content: Added drag select and also the ability to make custom models have physics. All new prefabs from the game have also been added.

notes.title: Custom models, official models, all the models!
notes.content:
Custom Models
Enjoy the freedom of infinite possibilities with custom models! Models can simply be added, exported, then loaded. Everything updates automatically in real-time. Note Trailmakers itself has some limitations when it comes to custom models.

Regular Models
With the help of Jess, and BreadAndButter, all new models added to Trailmakers is now added to Trailmappers! Many exciting new possibilities with so many additions. Say thanks to them in the official Trailmakers discord!

Other Additions

 Orthographic (flat) viewing is now possible with the gadget in the top right in the map editor!
 Saving and exporting is now asynchronous, so it is a lot faster to save/load.


Thank you all for supporting me in this endeavor, is has been fun getting back into this!
Also, if you come across any errors, please put the ERRORS (Trailmappers\Errors) in the official Trailmakers discord under the Trailmappers thread, also let me know of any bugs!

notes.title: More Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Fixed shield not exporting correctly
Fixed importing not working correctly
Hopefully fixed properties toggles all turning off
Fixed scale snapping not following snap settings

notes.title: Small Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Fixes

Fixed the dark plank set, made it selectable.
Fixed duplicate items.
Fixed scale inputs in properties not working correctly. 
Fixed the loader throwing errors when someone joins.

Additions

Added undo to arrow nudging.
Added the ability to switch to the unused axis with ctrl while arrow nudging.

notes.title: Models Galore!
notes.content:
A bunch of new models dropped in Trialmakers! These models have been ported to Trailmappers for your use!
Added editable outline transparency!
Added ability to completely disable the grid!

notes.title: New features are here!
notes.content:
Key binds are now not only plentiful, but also editable! Just go to options, controls, and edit to your preferences.
Arrow keys are now used for object transforming! Get detailed movements based off your snap factor!
Spawn points are now not a limiting factor! Now a spawn point object is in every map, edit it like any other object!
Due to request, resolutions, and a scalable window are possible, this can be found in graphics.
